segments.name: drilling services
segments.description: Provides contract drilling and directional drilling services to oil and natural gas operators in the United States, Colombia and Ecuador.
segments.evidence: Our contract drilling business operates in the continental United States and internationally in Colombia and Ecuador and, from time to time, we pursue contract drilling opportunities in other select markets.

segments.description: Provides integrated well completion services, including hydraulic fracturing, wireline, pumping and cementing, in active U.S. basins.

segments.name: drilling products

segments.evidence: We serve the energy and mining markets by manufacturing and distributing drill bits and downhole tools throughout North America and internationally in over 30 countries.
